# laravel_cloud_edge_networks (Data Source)

Lists the edge networks available to the organization. An edge network is a CDN zone; it carries no IP addresses. For egress IP ranges, use the laravel_cloud_ip_addresses data source instead. The list includes the shared edge network; filter by name, domain or status to pick one. Edge networks have no region or type to filter by.

~> This provider is in beta and may change between releases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laravel_cloud_edge_networks" "available" {}

# Filters match as substrings.
data "laravel_cloud_edge_networks" "mine" {
  domain = "example.com"
  status = "available"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Only list edge networks whose domain contains this value. The API matches it as a substring.
- `name` (String) Only list edge networks whose name contains this value. The API matches it as a substring.
- `status` (String) Only list edge networks whose status contains this value, such as `available`. The API matches it as a substring.

### Read-Only

- `edge_networks` (Attributes List) Available edge networks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--edge_networks))
- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--edge_networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `edge_networks`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the edge network was created.
- `domain` (String) Domain served by this edge network.
- `id` (String) Edge network ID.
- `name` (String) Edge network name.
- `status` (String) Edge network status (requesting, creating, available, deleting, deleted, unknown).
- `tenancy_type` (String) Tenancy type (shared, dedicated).
